operator: exact discrete quadratic tensor, independently checked on dense fields
frame: free co-moving increment,3 extra unknowns in both arms
common_ic: identical reconstruction of multistart head fit, same coefficients/frame at t0
native_ic: span Euclidean projection of identical original physical u0; separately labeled

solver.algorithm: adaptive diagonally-scaled LM with accepted/rejected trial history
solver.stagnation: rejected-trial or representable-step termination saved; never accepted as stationarity

qualification.tight_tighter_normalization: norm of original physical initial field

primary_criteria.head_benefit: Compare all 16 paired common-IC maximum evolved field errors; report ratio distribution and counts irrespective of favorable outcome.
primary_criteria.phase_shape: Physical wrapped energy-weighted circular centroids and diagnostic Fourier alignment; check each coordinate concentration at each time.
primary_criteria.no_retuning: No choice of settings, cases or model after fresh truth generation. No new training.

stopping_gates: qualification failure reported; no fresh-cohort tuning
retain all 16 outcomes and every operational attempt
diagnostics: coefficients,head codes,frame increments and accumulated centers
physical trial tangent normalized spectra including3frame variables
multistart fixed-frame distance from span to head
same-previous-state span solve seeded by reached head coefficients
outputs: summary.json, case_*/trajectory arrays, histories,source/config/hardware metadata; measured plots only

reference_refinement.scope: same grid discrete FOM, not continuum

time_refinement_scope: method-setting robustness: diffusion row weights also depend on dt; no temporal order claim
amendment: fresh confirmation, unchanged accepted p03b solver and selected method
family: original periodic NS3D two-potential family; source INITIAL_AMPLITUDE=0.2

fit_selection.choose: lowest-cost stationary candidate within band; otherwise preserve original winner and failure
fit_selection.retain: all candidate final codes, costs, gradients, histories; raw/selected indices; tie band; physical coefficient difference

centroid_diagnostic.threshold_scope: preregistered descriptive ambiguity flag, not a theorem or pass/fail accuracy gate
centroid_diagnostic.normalization: domain length=1; phase norm uses wrapped coordinate displacement
